suites.title: Eve Vakh - Badge Access Control & Deletion Security Suite

suites.title: Eve Vakh - Chat & Messaging Comprehensive Test Suite

specs.title: TC_CHAT_019: network disconnect during media/file upload stops progress, displays retry option, and prevents app freeze
TC_CHAT_020: sending messages while offline marks messages as Pending/Queued and automatically dispatches upon network restoration
TC_CHAT_021: unblocked user immediately restores real-time messaging capabilities without requiring app reload
TC_CHAT_022: attempting to create a group chat without selecting any members or with an empty group name is prevented
TC_CHAT_023: submitting an empty chat message (or message consisting solely of spaces, tabs, or newline characters) is blocked and the send button remains disabled
TC_CHAT_024: uploading files exceeding the maximum file size limit (e.g., >50MB or >100MB) immediately aborts with a File exceeds maximum allowed size toast
TC_CHAT_025: when a group chat is muted, @mention notifications either respect the mute setting or alert based on user preference settings
TC_CHAT_026: uploading unsupported file formats (.exe, .bat, .sh, .dmg, .dll, zero-byte empty files) in chat shows an Unsupported file format error and rejects the upload
TC_CHAT_027: sending messages with right-to-left (RTL) text (Arabic, Hebrew) mixed with LTR text, verifying bidirectional text isolation and layout stability
TC_CHAT_028: typing indicators: verify typing status disappears after 5 seconds of inactivity or if the user abruptly disconnects or closes the browser tab
TC_CHAT_029: concurrent messaging in group chats: when 10+ users send messages simultaneously, all messages are delivered in consistent chronological timestamp order
TC_CHAT_030: mutually blocked users in same existing group chat: verify message visibility and interaction restrictions inside shared group

suites.title: Eve Vakh - Explore Page Functional, UI/UX & Profile Forms Test Suite

specs.title: TC_EXP_005: should validate active filter button toggle and list responsiveness
TC_EXP_006: should navigate to user profile and display header details (username, joined, rep, tags)

suites.title: Eve Vakh - Home Page Full UI & Functional Test Suite

specs.title: TC_HOME_011: unhearting/unliking a post verifies whether daily heart budget is refunded or remains expended according to business rules
TC_HOME_012: feed pull-to-refresh during network disconnection maintains cached posts and displays non-intrusive offline banner
TC_HOME_013: non-admin or regular user attempting to trigger post approval or rejection API endpoints directly receives a 403 Forbidden error
TC_HOME_014: exact time boundary reset for hearts: liking at 5:29 AM IST (quota exhausted) and 5:31 AM IST (after 00:00 UTC reset) processes new heart
TC_HOME_015: moderation workflow: post author attempting to edit a post in Under Review status is blocked or updates without bypassing review

suites.title: Eve Vakh - Login Page Functional & Button Test Suite

specs.title: TC-05: submitting password exceeding 128 characters is handled cleanly without server timeout or 500 error
TC_AUTH_012: submitting a password with only whitespace characters or an empty string shows a mandatory validation error
TC_AUTH_013: entering alphanumeric or special characters into the OTP verification input is blocked and only numeric digits are accepted
TC_AUTH_014: boundary lengths for phone numbers: entering fewer than 7 digits or more than 15 digits displays invalid phone length error
TC_AUTH_015: entering Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) script tags in email/username/password inputs does not execute scripts and is safely escaped/rejected

suites.title: Eve Vakh - Post Creation & Composer Full Test Suite

specs.title: TC_POST_006: uploading corrupt or oversized media attachment halts submission and displays inline file error
TC_POST_007: submitting a new post while leaving mandatory form fields blank highlights errors and prevents post publication

suites.title: Eve Vakh - Account Recovery & 2FA Security Suite

specs.title: TC_REC_001: entering incorrect 2FA authenticator TOTP code 5 times disables further attempts for 15 minutes
TC_REC_002: entering an expired authenticator code from a previous 30-second TOTP interval fails with an invalid/expired code error
TC_REC_003: attempting account recovery with an unregistered email or phone number returns a generic security message preventing user enumeration
